description: This file defines an abstract class ResourceTypeField in the Drupal JSON:API module, representing metadata for a resource field including properties like internal name, public name, enabled status, and multiplicity. It provides methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

classes.name: ResourceTypeField
classes.description: An abstract class representing metadata for a JSON:API resource field, including properties such as internal name, public name, enabled status, and whether it has one or many values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the resource type field with internal name, optional public name, enabled status, and multiplicity.

methods.name: getInternalName
methods.description: Returns the internal name of the field.

methods.name: getPublicName
methods.description: Returns the public name of the field.

methods.name: withPublicName
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a specified public name.

methods.name: disabled
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the field marked as disabled.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the field marked as enabled.

methods.name: isFieldEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the field is enabled.

methods.name: hasOne
methods.description: Checks if the field can only have one value.

methods.name: hasMany
methods.description: Checks if the field can have many values.
